title: Every Separable Metric Space Extends to an Extreme One: paper and Lean 4 formalization

creators.name: Feldman, David Victor
creators.affiliation: University of New Hampshire, Department of Mathematics and Statistics

description: Every separable bounded-by-one pseudometric space embeds isometrically, with countable complement, into one whose metric is an extreme point of the metric body. The extension admits a canonical functorial form and is reversible, whence graph isomorphism Borel-reduces to isometry of extreme Polish metric spaces. Accompanied by a complete Lean 4 formalization: the development builds free of sorry, and every audited declaration depends only on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
